reason: Business outcomes need explicit acceptance criteria.
A governed production path includes enforced permissions.
Integration behaviour needs a recovery plan.
Review throughput requires an operational owner.
Economic viability depends on knowing who owns maintenance and costs after handover.
Demonstrations hide scale limits; production requires ongoing revalidation under real load.
Proportionate risk controls determine what fails gracefully and what needs manual override.
You cannot evaluate accurate output without shared, unambiguous business definitions.
Data blind spots and missing history define the edge cases you must test.
Teams adopt and learn faster when starting with simpler, inspectable tools.
